title: Monitoring Cloud Connectors: which surface answers which question

prose.text: Cloud and Branch Connector health and traffic are visible in the Admin Console, in streamed logs, and in a few API reads. This subject points each question at the surface that answers it.

prose.label: Fleet and status.
prose.text: {{monitoring-pages}} What Active, Inactive and Disabled mean, and what the API reports per VM, is in [[cloud-connector.insights.connector-status]].

prose.label: Traffic.
prose.text: {{insights-pages}} Their controls, logs pages and limits are in [[cloud-connector.insights.analytics]].

prose.label: Programmatic access.
prose.text: {{no-insights-api}} Streamed logs are the programmatic path, in [[cloud-connector.logs]] and [[cloud-connector.nss-va]]. Upgrade state has its own API read, in [[cloud-connector.upgrades.monitoring]].

prose.label: Alerts.
prose.text: How state changes reach an operator is in [[cloud-connector.insights.alerting]].

checks.do: Whether the question is about connector state (Monitoring page, VM record) or about traffic (Insights, session logs), before choosing a surface.

monitoring-pages.statement: The Cloud & Branch Connector Monitoring pages show the name, group, location, geolocation and status of deployed connector VMs, and are refreshed on demand with a Refresh icon.

quotes: The Cloud & Branch Connector Monitoring pages provide information on the name, group, location, geolocation, and status of your Cloud and Branch Connector virtual machines (VMs)
You can use the Refresh icon to refresh the dashboard to view the most recent information.

insights-pages.statement: The Insights pages (Session, DNS and Tunnel Insights) chart each transaction processed by the Zscaler service and let an admin drill down with filters and operators.

quotes: View insights for each transaction processed by the Zscaler service on any chart type of your choice.
Quickly drill down on insights with the help of multiple filters and operators available.
go to Data Explorer > Zero Trust Cloud > Session/DNS/Tunnel Insights

no-insights-api.statement: No Insights or Insights-logs read appears in the Cloud & Branch Connector API: the captured API reference has no path for Session, DNS or Tunnel insights or their logs, and the help's API overview lists no such feature.
no-insights-api.conditions: Rests on a search: the 96 paths of the captured Cloud & Branch Connector OpenAPI document contain no insight path (the only log-like paths are the audit log report and its download), and the API overview's feature list names no Insights area. The console offers a log Download (cloud-connector.insights.analytics:insights-logs-pages), which is not an API.

quotes: The Zscaler Cloud & Branch Connector API gives you programmatic access to the following Zscaler Cloud & Branch Connector features:
